name: Contractor Notice of Affirmative Abuse/Misconduct Background Responses
description: Contractors must tell the District in writing when a contractor employee answers yes to any abuse or sexual misconduct background question, so the District can object to the assignment.
deadline: upon receipt of an affirmative response, before assignment
quote: Independent contractors shall inform the District, in writing, upon receipt of an affirmative response to any of the abuse and sexual misconduct background questions for a contractor employee. If the District objects to the assignment, the independent contractor may not assign the contractor employee to the District.
